text:
anya: opened a small PR to adjust our examples for tool outputs that used nullable unions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

felix: quick peek  what exactly are we changing? i noticed a couple of failing snippet-tests in CI.

anya: were avoiding inline union nulls in tool responses. e.g. `items: string | null` -> `items: { values: string[], present: boolean }` or `nullable: true` explicit. this makes SDK parsers deterministic.

sofia: +1 to deterministic parsing. please add a brief migration note in /docs/migration/advise-tool-calling.md so customers know why examples look different.

anya: will add one-liner and a before/after snippet. also updated js and python quickstart samples.

felix: found two places in `snippets/legacy/` that still use the old pattern. can you patch those too? they break our snippet-lint job.

anya: patched legacy ones, and added a test in `tools/example-validator` which runs sample outputs through node/python parsers.

docs-bot: CI error  docs-link-check found 1 broken internal link: /docs/old-tool-guide -> 404

sofia: that link was removed in last sprint. either add a redirect or update the migration doc to point to the new guide.

anya: updated migration doc and added redirect in `_redirects.yml`. re-running CI.

felix: LGTM on snippet changes. left a tiny comment on formatting of presence wrapper example (prefer `present: false` over `present: 0`).

anya: thanks, fixed formatting and pushed. CI is green. merging after one more approval.

sofia: i'll add a short blurb to the release notes about docs examples changing for parser compatibility.

anya: perfect. merging now. closing thread. :sparkles:
